//: CI test-suite manifest (2026-08-07; smoke bucket added 2026-08-23). scripts/run-test-manifest.js runs the RUNNABLE buckets and enforces COMPLETENESS: every tests/*.test.js on disk must appear in exactly one bucket, so a new suite can never be silently orphaned again (35 were, including every money/pricing suite). Buckets: node = RUNNABLE, unit-suite-manifest CI job; smoke = RUNNABLE, smoke-tests CI job, object-valued so each suite carries the step documentation it had when ci.yml listed it by hand; emulator = individual proxy-scrubbed emulators:exec steps in ci.yml; wired-individually = suites a workflow still runs by name (the count is not repeated here — it rots: this line said 10 while the bucket held 14; run-test-manifest.js --check prints the live figures); quarantined = known-red with a dated reason, not run. Bucket sizes are ratcheted by FLOORS in scripts/run-test-manifest.js — shrinking one fails CI.
//smoke: The suites the smoke-tests CI job runs through scripts/run-test-manifest.js --bucket smoke. Each value is the step documentation migrated verbatim from ci.yml (2026-08-23) when 65 hand-written steps collapsed into one aggregated runner; the runner reports EVERY failure instead of aborting at the first. A non-empty doc is enforced by the runner, so this text is a gated asset rather than a courtesy. Order is ci.yml stakes order. smoke.test.js deliberately keeps its own ci.yml step.
